{{Top|leg}}
The '''AE-35 subspace transceiver''' acted as the comms relay for various TIE series starfighters. It was often necessary for any missions that dealt with significantly hazardous topography in space, such as [[Asteroid field]]s. In order to function, the relays needed to be within proximity of a TIE squadron, as otherwise it would break down. It also included a distress beacon in the event that a TIE fighter was lost in space or crash-landed.
